thread:
arjun: quick sync — we need to lock the multi-region windows for the v2.19 bump. proposing a small stagger so APAC gets the late-evening canary, EU gets early-morning, US midday. thoughts?

maya: can you paste the exact cutoffs? i want to double-check migration window overlap with analytics jobs.

arjun: yup. here's the proposal (UTC):
```
APAC canary start: 21:30 UTC (APAC local evening)
APAC full rollout: 22:30 UTC
EU canary start: 02:00 UTC
EU full rollout: 03:00 UTC
US canary start: 15:00 UTC
US full rollout: 16:00 UTC
branch freeze cutoff for feature merges: 14:00 UTC (same day)
changelog cutoff: 12:00 UTC
DB migration freeze window: 13:00-17:00 UTC (we only run migrations in US window)
```

arjun: want to keep the changelog cutoff earlier so product can finish notes.

zach: sound reasonable. question — if a blocker pops in APAC canary, do we rollback APAC only or pause other regions?

jen (sre): prefer pausing downstream but not automatically rolling back EU/US unless it's a shared infra issue. plan: APAC pause + alert channel, then triage.

kevin: note on branch coordination — pls ensure any RS changes that touch kv-cache are merged before 12:00 UTC or feature flagged. merging after freeze will require explicit oncall approval.

maya: analytics jobs — we should gate heavy ETL between 00:00-04:00 UTC. the EU canary at 02:00 overlaps; can we move EU canary to 03:00?

arjun: ok small tweak: EU canary -> 03:30 UTC, EU full -> 04:30 UTC. updated plan in thread.

deploy-bot: [deployment-schedule] v2.19 canary windows created: APAC 21:30 UTC, EU 03:30 UTC, US 15:00 UTC. Canary channel set: #releases-canary. :robot_face:

kevin: changelog nudge — please add one-sentence bullets for user-facing changes. i’ll compile. deadline 12:00 UTC.

maya: tagging @analytics-team — avoid heavy jobs 03:00-05:00 UTC if possible.

analytics-team (automated): acknowledged. will throttle nightly ETL by 40% during the window.

zach: quick q on rollback strategy — are we using model-variant fallback for generation models? or full service rollback?

jen (sre): model-variant fallback enabled for hosted API routes. non-model infra issues -> service rollback. doc link: https://internal.redwood/ops/rollbacks (ping if you need access).

arjun: last ask — can reviewers prioritize changelog PRs and any merge conflicts in the morning? if anyone needs a hand ping me.

maya: i'll be online for the 12:00-14:00 UTC merge window to help unblock.

zach: will give CRs for the kv-cache changes by 11:30 UTC.

jen (sre): i'll hang out on-call during APAC canary in case of infra noise.

kevin: one more — reminder: feature flags for DB migrations mandatory. add rollback SQL ready.

arjun: thanks everyone. final plan set — APAC 21:30 canary, EU 03:30 canary, US 15:00 canary. branch freeze 14:00 UTC, changelog cutoff 12:00 UTC. i'll update the release doc and ping #releases-canary. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled reminders set: changelog cutoff @ 12:00 UTC, branch freeze @ 14:00 UTC, canary start alerts posted 30m before each window.
